ns2:course.label: Sustainable Development in South Asia
ns2:course.description: Examination of sustainable development in the region of South Asia (India, Nepal, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka). Geographic analysis of development processes since the colonial period, with particular emphasis on the interrelated processes of environment, society, and politics as related to sustainability. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Sophomore standing or consent of instructor.
